page.notes: The first word "cidere," is a fragment cut off at the left edge of the page (probably the end of "excidere"); kept as printed. Doubtful: "suus sit" (the word after "fuus" may read "fit"). The line-end word "praete" / "ritus" and "confecutu" / "rum" are broken without a visible hyphen; written whole. Running head and text in capitals use V for U as printed; converted to U where it is a vowel. "ridi-cule" keeps the printed hyphen. The final line ends "FI-" with a printed hyphen; the catchword "LIVS" is given as LIUS.
